facts.business: Kuber Udyog Limited is engaged in gold trading, equity share trading, lending, and advisory IT services, banking regulatory consulting, non-fund-based banking services, investment activity, and bank relationship management.

auditor.name: Bilimoria Mehta & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: The Company filed for surrender of its NBFC Certificate of Registration and does not meet eligibility criteria for NBFC classification as of March 31, 2026. The Company has diversified into advisory IT services, banking regulatory consulting, non-fund-based banking services, investment activity, and bank relationship management.

key_risks: Surrender of NBFC Certificate of Registration pending with RBI
Company does not meet eligibility criteria for NBFC classification as of March 31, 2026
Diversification into new business lines (advisory IT services, banking regulatory consulting, etc.)
Resignation of statutory auditors during the year
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
